metadata.provenance: Derived from the PIP $8.30/day (2021 PPP) headcount and WDI population.
metadata.method: Count in crore = million people / 10. The upper-middle-income line count uses WDI SI.POV.UMIC headcount multiplied by WDI SP.POP.TOTL and divided by 1 crore.
metadata.note: Original million-person counts are retained in the source artifacts and article prose.
metadata.lineUpdate: The World Bank updated the previous $6.85/day line in 2017 PPP to $8.30/day in 2021 PPP.
